paragraphs: The Institution Management System is a web-based application built using Laravel, PHP, and Blade templating, designed to streamline administrative processes in educational and training institutions. The system provides user authentication, student and staff management, course handling, and dynamic reporting with an intuitive interface powered by Bootstrap and JavaScript.

whatItDoes.text: The Institution Management System is a web-based application built using Laravel, PHP, and Blade templating, designed to streamline administrative processes in educational and training institutions.
